en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a winter forest scene where a group of uniformed men, likely military volunteers, are gathered around a small campfire among snow and trees. Some hold axes and appear to be cutting wood while others tend the fire. The men wear dark uniforms and caps typical of early 20th‑century European military attire. Printed text in Swedish appears at the top of the image.
